prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The lease agreement will _____ automatically unless either party gives written notice sixty days in advance.
options: renew
remove
resist
reveal

wrong.remove: remove 是「移除」，租約若被移除就不會說 automatically 與提前通知的關係。
wrong.resist: resist 是「抵抗」，不能當作租約自動延續的動詞。
wrong.reveal: reveal 是「揭露」，與租約自動續約的意思無關。

why: unless 後面提到需要通知才能終止，所以租約預設是自動續約 renew。
say: The lease agreement will renew automatically unless either party gives written notice sixty days in advance.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: Both parties must sign the contract before it becomes legally _____.
options: valid
vivid
visible
various

wrong.vivid: vivid 是「鮮明的、生動的」，不能用來說合約有法律效力。
wrong.visible: visible 是「看得見的」，與合約是否有效無關。
wrong.various: various 是「各式各樣的」，不能作 becomes 後的形容詞。

why: 簽署後合約才具法律效力，valid 是「有效的」。
tip: legally valid = 在法律上有效。
say: Both parties must sign the contract before it becomes legally valid.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的商務英文？
options: The contract was terminated because the client failed to pay on time.
The contract terminated because the client failed paying on time.
The contract was terminate because the client failed to pay on time.
The contract was terminated because the client was failing pay on time.
answer: The contract was terminated because the client failed to pay on time.

wrong.The contract terminated because the clie: 合約是被終止，要用被動式；fail 後面接 to V，不是 V-ing。
wrong.The contract was terminate because the c: 被動語態要用過去分詞 terminated。
wrong.The contract was terminated because the: was failing pay 語法不通；fail 要接 to pay。

why: 合約被終止用被動式 was terminated；fail to + 原形。
tip: fail to + 原形；合約用被動 be terminated。
say: The contract was terminated because the client failed to pay on time.

prompt: 你的法務同事說合約要有人負責賠償損失。你想問誰承擔責任，哪一句最合適？
options: Who is liable if the goods are damaged during transport?
Who is liability if the goods are damaged during transport?
Who liable is if the goods damaged during transport?
Who is liable if the goods damaging during transport?
answer: Who is liable if the goods are damaged during transport?

wrong.Who is liability if the goods are damage: liability 是名詞，be 動詞後面要接形容詞 liable 表示有責任。
wrong.Who liable is if the goods damaged durin: 疑問句語序錯誤，且 goods 前面缺少被動 be 動詞。
wrong.Who is liable if the goods damaging duri: 貨物是被損壞，要用被動 are damaged，不是 damaging。

why: be liable for 表示須負責；貨物是被損壞，用被動式。
tip: liable 是形容詞；liability 是名詞。
say: Who is liable if the goods are damaged during transport?

text: The vendor shall deliver all items no later than March 15, unless otherwise agreed in writing.
options: 除非書面另有同意，供應商最遲須在三月十五日前交貨。
供應商可以在三月十五日之後任何時間交貨。
供應商必須在三月十五日才開始製作商品。
供應商與買方已經在三月十五日簽約。
answer: 除非書面另有同意，供應商最遲須在三月十五日前交貨。

wrong.供應商可以在三月十五日之後任何時間交貨。: no later than 是「不遲於」，三月十五日是最後期限。
wrong.供應商必須在三月十五日才開始製作商品。: 原句說的是交貨期限，沒有說開始製作時間。
wrong.供應商與買方已經在三月十五日簽約。: 三月十五日是交貨日，不是簽約日。

why: no later than 是最遲期限，unless otherwise agreed in writing 是除非書面另有約定。
tip: no later than = 最遲不超過。
say: The vendor shall deliver all items no later than March 15, unless otherwise agreed in writing.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The company agreed to _____ the client for any losses caused by the software error.
options: compensate
compete
complete
compare

wrong.compete: compete 是「競爭」，不能接 client for losses 表示賠償。
wrong.complete: complete 是「完成」，與補償損失無關。
wrong.compare: compare 是「比較」，無法用在賠償對象和損失的句型。

why: compensate someone for loss 是「賠償某人的損失」。
say: The company agreed to compensate the client for any losses caused by the software error.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的商務英文？
options: Any changes to this agreement must be made in writing.
Any change to this agreement must made in writing.
Any changes to this agreement must be make in writing.
Any changes of this agreement must be made on writing.
answer: Any changes to this agreement must be made in writing.

wrong.Any change to this agreement must made i: must 後面缺少 be，被動語態要寫 must be made。
wrong.Any changes to this agreement must be ma: 被動式 be 後面要用過去分詞 made，不是原形 make。
wrong.Any changes of this agreement must be ma: change 後面通常接 to，in writing 才是固定說法，不是 on writing。

why: must be made 是被動式，in writing 是固定片語，表示以書面形式。
say: Any changes to this agreement must be made in writing.
